SELECTORS (updated under #792): two scoped data-testids were ADDED to RemediationGuideBody.tsx to make the two text-content claims #925 could only cover indirectly directly assertable — `[data-testid="remediation-progress"]` on the "N of M steps resolved" span (RemediationGuideBody.tsx, the standfirst progress row) and `[data-testid="remediation-selection-notice"]` on the #658 no-findings notice banner div (rendered only when the live guide collapsed to the two standing steps). Per-step assertions still target the one pre-existing stable hook — each step's `<button role="checkbox" aria-checked aria-label="Mark Step N complete: <title>">` — via `[role="checkbox"][aria-label^="Mark Step N complete"]` plus `[aria-checked="true"|"false"]` (assumes step.label === "Step N", true for the current catalogue). No per-step <code>-block testid was added, so the script-parameterization real-value-vs-<placeholder> claim stays a DATA-level assertion via /api/portal/tenant-check-items (see the #776/#782 note below), not a DOM assertion.

PROSE-GENERATION (Shane correction, #792): the remediation guide is NOT fetched as generated HTML by a numeric document id and previewed via a ?preview=design fixture — that older doc-id lookup pipeline no longer drives this document. On a live tenant the guide is rendered CLIENT-SIDE as generated prose: DocumentBody.tsx:555 intercepts on doc.title === JOURNEY_REMEDIATION_DOCUMENT ('Full Remediation Guide — Copilot Gate Clearance Plan', journeyTokens.ts:399) and mounts LiveRemediationGuideBody, whose text is assembled synchronously per-tenant in remediationLiveGuide.ts (resolveStandfirst/resolveClosing/resolveHandoffBlurb/resolveDynamicSelectionNotice etc.) plus fixed section headings from previewRemediationGuide.ts's REMEDIATION_GUIDE constant. The numeric LiveBody fetch of /api/portal/assessment/documents/:id is the OLD pipeline and is never reached for this doc. So the test READS THE REAL RENDERED PROSE OFF THE SCREEN (post-#1016 textContains against the live DOM), not a pre-seeded doc-id/preview fixture. There is no {{TEST_REMEDIATION_PREVIEW_DOC_ID}} anymore.

TEXT ASSERTIONS ARE LIVE (post-#1016): the WPF UiTestExecutor `expect` reads an element's real rendered text — `EvaluateExpectOnceAsync` asserts `el.innerText ?? el.textContent` contains any of a step's `textContains` phrases (case-insensitive), composing with `state`. `textContains` accepts a single string or an any-of array. This manifest reads the generated prose straight off the live guide: the always-present [data-testid="document-reading-pane"] scroll container (copilot-readiness-documents.tsx:872, which wraps the mounted guide) carries the whole guide's innerText, so each stable, tenant-independent prose string produced by the generator (standfirst 'This is a runbook.' — remediationLiveGuide.ts:979; h1 'Every step required to clear the Copilot Gate'; section headings 'Remediation Overview' / 'Executive Summary'; handoff 'If you would rather not run this yourself') is asserted as a separate expect against that pane. The #658 no-findings notice's REAL copy is asserted against [data-testid="remediation-selection-notice"] (any-of covers resolveDynamicSelectionNotice's two branches). The 'N of M reflects the REAL rendered count, not a hardcoded number' claim is pinned to the deterministic never-scanned denominator (literal 2 — only the two standing steps render) via [data-testid="remediation-progress"].

DYNAMIC SELECTION (#658) — proven entirely from the LIVE screen (no preview fixture): s18 and s28 are gap steps (STEP_CHECK_GAPS — no check-key mapping) that rendersInLiveGuide() filters out (only finding/process steps render live), so they are ABSENT on the live guide. s27/s30 are PROCESS_ONLY_STEP_IDS and always render. The decisive proof is the never-scanned tenant: it renders EXACTLY s27+s30 (every finding-driven step absent) AND surfaces the resolveDynamicSelectionNotice banner — asserted in the re-login block. On a scanned tenant, s27/s30 present + s18/s28 absent shows the live guide is the dynamically-selected per-tenant list, not a static 28-step catalogue.

TWO TENANT STATES ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE (same class of limit 891 documented): the scanned-tenant assertions and the never-scanned assertions need different accounts. This manifest switches tenants mid-run via a second /login; if only one test account is provisioned, the other block's steps WARN rather than fail meaningfully. Run each block against the matching tenant.

DEEP-LINK PRECONDITION: the live guide renders only when the Remediation Guide document is the ACTIVE reader at /copilot-readiness/documents/:docId (route copilot-readiness-documents.tsx:573 — :docId is the numeric platform doc id via String(d.id)===docId; there is no stable slug). The runner must supply the numeric doc ids as config variables (see VARIABLES). RECOMMENDATION: give the remediation guide a stable slug or a title-keyed sidebar row testid so this stops being a per-tenant precondition.

SCRIPT PARAMETERIZATION (#776/#782) — assertable vs not: real-value-vs-<placeholder> substitution happens client-side in remediationScriptParams.ts against /api/portal/tenant-check-items data, landing in an untestid'd <code> block, so 'real value appears / no <placeholder> brackets' is NOT DOM-assertable today. What IS asserted here: the tenant-check-items feed returns for the five fillable checks — s1 sharepoint:orgwide-links, s9 identity:ca-policy-count, s11 identity:global-admin-count, s12 security:safe-links-coverage, s22 cost:group-based-licensing-adoption (FILLABLE_STEP_CHECK_KEYS). s5 and s14 are DELIBERATELY excluded from FILLABLE_STEP_CHECK_KEYS and must always stay literal (<m365-governance@your-domain>, <all-staff@your-domain>) — never substituted. Once testids exist: assert containsNone:["<"] on the s1/s9/s11/s12/s22 code blocks where the tenant has real data, and containsAny:["<"] on the s5/s14 blocks.

#782 FIELD-NAME AUDIT CAVEAT (unproven — do this before trusting a green s1/s9/s12/s22): per #782's own honesty note, only s11 was ever confirmed against real monitor_checks data; s1/s9/s12/s22 are unproven against live collected items. Reconcile against remediationScriptParams.ts's field lists — s1 SITE_URL_FIELDS=["Url","SiteUrl","webUrl","siteUrl","url"]; s9 CA_ID_FIELDS=["id","Id"]; s11 ADMIN_ID_FIELDS=["id"]+ADMIN_ODATA_TYPE_FIELD="@odata.type" (CONFIRMED); s12 SAFE_LINKS_NAME_FIELDS=["Name","name","Identity","identity"]; s22 GROUP_DISPLAY_NAME_FIELDS=["displayName","DisplayName"] + regex /^LIC-[^-]+-(.+)$/i. Audit SQL: SELECT key, properties FROM monitor_checks WHERE key IN ('sharepoint:orgwide-links','identity:ca-policy-count','identity:global-admin-count','security:safe-links-coverage','cost:group-based-licensing-adoption'); — if a check's collected item field name is not in the matching list, substitution silently falls back to <placeholder> and the field list (not this manifest) is the bug. Do NOT silently flip these assertions to green without this audit.

VERIFIED STATE CANNOT BE FORCED: verificationState flips to 'verified' only when a real re-scan (runDiagnostics -> reverifyRemediationTrackerSteps, remediation-tracker-verification.ts) finds ALL of a step's mapped checks clean; EVERY tracker write resets verificationState to 'unverified' (portal-remediation-tracker.ts). The runner can trigger a rescan (debug-trigger-scan, 202) but cannot deterministically make real findings clean. Two consequences: (a) LIVE PRICING — partial progress (completed but unverified) does NOT drop the price, asserted deterministically below (Phase 1 fee stays 16200 = governance 9800 + security 6400 after ticking a Phase-1 step); the price only drops after a phase is fully resolved AND re-scanned-clean, which is precondition-gated (needs a tenant whose Phase-1 checks genuinely pass) and is a manual spot-check. (b) EVIDENCE PACK HONESTY — evidence-pack.pdf includes only steps with a real verified finding (server gate portal-remediation-tracker-export.ts:149, joined to msp_diagnostic_findings severity 'ok'); the endpoint returning a real %PDF is asserted, but that it OMITS non-verified steps is a binary-PDF content claim → manual spot-check (same honesty-limit spirit as #888/#891).

PDF CONTENT: export.pdf and evidence-pack.pdf are asserted to be real, non-empty PDFs (body starts with %PDF) — full visual/layout correctness is not machine-checked; open the file to spot-check. CSV export IS content-checked (header row Step,Title,Pillar,Status,...).

RESCAN REVERIFY IS ASYNC: debug-trigger-scan returns 202 immediately and reverifyRemediationTrackerSteps runs inside the async runDiagnostics, so this manifest asserts the TRIGGER, not the post-scan verified/drift flip (that needs polling the run to completion then re-reading the tracker — a follow-up once the runner grows a poll primitive, cf. #877's mail-poll extract).

#757 MIGRATION CHECK is read-only SQL for Shane, NOT asserted via the app: the app cannot observe whether the orphan-row DELETE ran, only that s24/s25 are rejected (which this manifest DOES assert as a code-level regression, PUT s24/s25 -> 400). Confirm the DB-level cleanup with lib/db/migrations/manual/archive/diagnostics/2026-08-12-remediation-tracker-s24-s25-cleanup-verify-757.sql.
